project.title: Pilot rollout readiness (process not named in sources)

groups.name: Process owner (to be named)
groups.purpose: Accountable for the piloted process end to end: resolves blocked cases, approves scope changes, decides go/no-go for wider rollout, and is the escalation point during adoption. No source names this actor; the request states explicitly that no process owner exists yet.

members.role: To be named by an executive sponsor

flags.detail: The rollout request confirms no process owner is currently named. Do not proceed to company-wide rollout with this open.

decisions.question: Who is the named process owner accountable for this pilot and its company-wide rollout?
What is the root cause behind 8 of 10 pilot cases being blocked (80%), and is each one resolved, reassigned or cancelled before scope expands?

Given only 2 completed and 8 blocked pilot cases and no named owner, does the organization accept delaying the company-wide date beyond next week in favor of a remediation phase and a second, larger pilot cohort, or proceed on the original date at reduced scope?
